name: What preparation do I need to do before painting starts on my addition?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do before painting starts on my addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before painting starts on your addition, you typically need to ensure the space is clear and accessible for the painting crew. This involves removing any personal belongings, fragile items, or furniture from the area. If applicable, covering existing flooring that won't be replaced during the construction phase can also be beneficial, though our team will take measures to protect surfaces. You should also finalize all color and finish selections with us beforehand to avoid delays once the work begins. Preparing the site adequately helps our team work efficiently and minimizes potential issues during the painting process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before painting, clear the addition, remove fragile items, and finalize all color and finish selections.
